about: BICs that Italian banks publish on their own websites, read on 7 October 2026 for the ABI codes the rebuild of 29 September 2026 left without a BIC. Used by scripts/derive-map-keys.ts as the last step of the Italian derivation: a website may only choose among the head-office BICs GLEIF already pairs with the bank, and a code outside the Banca d'Italia registers needs a sentence of the bank carrying the code itself (abi_quote). Only the bank's own domain or its group's is accepted, never a directory of IBAN or BIC codes. Each quote is the text of the page or document, markup removed and runs of white space collapsed, never paraphrased.
